name: RentSpree
positioning: Rental screening distributed through the MLS — the reason so many US agents handle rentals at all.
description: RentSpree provides online rental applications, tenant screening reports from TransUnion, e-signature, rent payment and rent reporting. It is distributed through partnerships with MLSs and associations, which makes it the default rental workflow for a large share of US agents.
real_estate_use: An agent listing a rental sends one link. The applicant completes the application, pays the screening fee themselves, and authorises the credit, criminal and eviction report — so the agent never handles sensitive data or fronts a cost. For agents whose main business is sales, that low friction is why the rental side is worth doing at all.
features: TransUnion credit, criminal and eviction reports
Lease e-signature and rent payment collection
Agent referral and client management tools

use_cases.job: Screen rental applicants without touching payment or sensitive data
Collect a complete, verified application file before deciding
